objective_checks.detail: changing docs/guide.md routes as expected across 3 workflow(s)
changing src/index.js routes as expected across 3 workflow(s)
changing package-lock.json routes as expected across 3 workflow(s)
changing README.md, LICENSE routes as expected across 3 workflow(s)
required check(s) always fire and gate internally (.github/workflows/tests.yml)
event-only workflows carry no path filters (.github/workflows/nightly-sweep.yml, .github/workflows/triage.yml)

dimensions.name: Completeness
dimensions.rationale: All five pull_request/push and non-path workflows received a deliberate decision, and the required check (tests.yml) is given exactly the one correct shape — a single workflow with no workflow-level paths/paths-ignore, gating real work via a computed `run` output with `if:`, and no companion skip workflow duplicating the check name.

dimensions.name: Salience
dimensions.rationale: Each workflow's paths are tailored to what it consumes (deploy: src/package/deploy.sh; docs-site: docs/mkdocs; tests grep: src/test/package.json+lock with the lockfile trap covered) plus a self-reference, rather than catch-alls, though the exact step-level fit can't be fully verified from the diff shown.

dimensions.name: Restraint
dimensions.rationale: The schedule-only (nightly-sweep) and issue-driven (triage) workflows were left untouched, the branch-protection ruleset was not modified, and no files beyond the four workflows in scope were edited.
